title: This Indian kitchen ingredient being used since ancient times can replace aluminium foil, and looks super cool too
description: Banana leaves are celebrated across various cultures for their role in food wrapping and presentation, offering an array of benefits. They're a sustainable choice, being both biodegradable and compostable, a marked improvement from plastic options. It's worth noting that banana leaves may not hold up for extended preservation or intense heat cooking. With proper preparation, including washing and softening, they greatly enhance their food packaging potential.

title: Neanderthals may have used prehistoric glue as an ancient antibiotic
description: Neanderthals may have used a sticky substance made from birch bark to treat wounds thousands of years before antibiotics existed. Researchers recreated ancient birch tar production techniques and discovered that every sample could inhibit the growth of bacteria responsible for dangerous wound infections. Previously known mainly as a prehistoric glue, birch tar may have doubled as a surprisingly effective natural medicine.
